title: Optimal trade entry on 15m: buy a 62-79% pullback of a structure-breaking impulse, target its high

source.title: Optimal Trade Entry (LuxAlgo Library)
source.license: LuxAlgo Library licence: free to use with attribution

rule_summary: Chart 15m, closed bars; signal at the close of bar t, fill at the next open E. LEG (evaluated each bar): H1 = highest high of bars t-24..t-1, at index h (latest if tied); L0 = lowest low of bars h-24..h-1, at index l. The leg QUALIFIES when (H1 - L0)/L0 >= 0.025 AND H1 > highest high of the 96 bars l-96..l-1 (the impulse broke the prior 24-hour high: a structure break). R = H1 - L0. OTE BAND: H1 - 0.79R to H1 - 0.62R. SETUP holds when, after bar h: some bar has low <= H1 - 0.62R (price reached the band), no bar has low < L0, and no bar has high > H1. ENTRY (confirmation option): while the setup holds, bar t closes above high(t-1) AND close(t) >= H1 - 0.79R, AND the last closed 1h candle closes above the SMA(50) of 1h closes (higher-timeframe filter d); buy at the next open E. One entry per leg (per H1). STOP: min(0.998*L0, 0.99*E), fixed at entry, executed intrabar. TARGET: H1 (the anchoring swing high). TIME EXIT: 48 bars (12 h) after entry. One position per pair, same numbers on all pairs.
mechanism: OTE (ICT, as written in the LuxAlgo Library) buys a deep 62-79% retracement of a displacement leg that broke structure, with the stop beyond the leg origin. LuxAlgo says the ratios have no mechanical force; the honest mechanism is that an impulse strong enough to break the 24-hour high reveals a large buyer, the retracement is profit-taking by short-term longs plus shorts selling what looks like a failed breakout, and if the buyer is still accumulating (persistent order flow) price returns to the swing high, where breakout stops sit. The 1h trend filter and the confirmation bar carry the weight. Counterparty: pullback sellers and shorts with stops above H1. Move per trade: entry about 0.3R above L0, target about 0.7R away; with R >= 2.5% the target is at least 1.7% and the stop about 1%, so a 45-50% hit rate gives about +0.4 to +0.7% gross; estimate 0.55%.
